notes.purpose: Policy file for the KswordARKDriver IOCTL static auditor.
notes.allowedAnyAccess: Add a full IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_* name here only when FILE_ANY_ACCESS is intentional and documented.
notes.allowedAnyAccessWhy: All four are keyword false positives, not exceptions: QUERY_UNLOADED_DRIVERS matches UNLOAD, HWID_DISPATCH_QUERY matches PATCH, QUERY_APP_CONTROL_STATUS matches CONTROL, QUERY_PROCESS_PROTECT_STATE matches PROTECT. Each is a read-only query; requiring FILE_WRITE_ACCESS would break the read path without closing anything. The list exists so the audit can gate the build on HIGH findings - it stays empty of genuine exceptions.
notes.readPrimitiveGap: The auditor classifies by mutating/query keyword only, so it does not flag read primitives that are themselves privilege escalation - arbitrary physical or virtual memory reads disclose whatever the caller cannot otherwise see. Those were gated by hand on 2026-09-12 and now show up as query_write_access MEDIUM findings, which is the expected shape rather than a regression.
notes.mutatingKeywords: Tokens that usually indicate state-changing or destructive operations and should not stay FILE_ANY_ACCESS by default.
notes.queryKeywords: Tokens that usually indicate read-only/query operations and should not require FILE_WRITE_ACCESS unless there is a documented reason.
notes.ignoredHeaders: Use repository-relative paths or basenames for protocols owned by a different driver project.
